uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Map Knowledge on this device. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature is the warm paper look of Sephral's modules, Foundry follows Foundry's dark windows.

openPanel.name: Open the window with the tools
openPanel.hint: Opens the Map Knowledge window whenever you pick the Map Knowledge tools.

overlayColor.name: Tint of unknown areas
overlayColor.hint: Color that covers what the players do not know when you show their knowledge.

overlayOpacity.name: Strength of the tint
overlayOpacity.hint: How strongly the tint covers unknown areas.

notifyPlayers.name: Tell players about changes
notifyPlayers.hint: Players get a short notice when you reveal or hide areas for them.

Controls.title: Map Knowledge
Controls.rect: Rectangle: drag across the map (Shift for a square)
Controls.ellipse: Ellipse: drag across the map (Shift for a circle)
Controls.polygon: Polygon: click the corners, double click or click the first corner to finish, right click removes the last corner
Controls.room: Room: click into a room, the walls are its border
Controls.hideMode: Hide instead of reveal (or hold Alt)

Panel.title: Map Knowledge
Panel.menuHint: The window with the players, the whole Level, sharing and the undo.
Panel.sharedNote: This scene shares one fog of war, so every change counts for all players.
Panel.noPlayers: This world has no players yet.
Panel.offline: Offline, gets it on the next visit
Panel.hideWholeConfirm: The chosen players forget this whole Level. Their tokens see again what is in sight.
Panel.shareHint: The chosen players also learn everything this player knows of this Level.
Panel.toolsHint: Drag, click corners or click into a room. Hold Alt to hide.

Notice.gmOnly: Only a GM can change what the players know.
Notice.noFogApi: Map Knowledge needs Foundry 14 and cannot reach its fog of war here. Run the self test in the module settings.
Notice.noVision: This scene has no token vision, so there is no fog of war. Turn on token vision in the scene settings.
Notice.noExploration: This scene does not remember explored areas. Turn on fog exploration in the scene settings.
Notice.failed: {failed} players did not get the change, {done} did.
Notice.noSnapshot: {missing} players could not get the area back, their earlier map was not kept.
Notice.unanswered: {count} players did not answer. The GM saved the change for them, their screens load the fog again.
Notice.noPlayers: Nobody is chosen, so nothing changed.
Notice.sourceKnowsNothing: {name} knows nothing of this Level yet.
Notice.noRoom: There is no room at this point.
Notice.polygonTooSmall: A polygon needs at least three corners.
Notice.playerLearned: The GM showed you more of the map of {scene}.
Notice.playerLearnedUnnamed: The GM showed you more of the map.
Notice.playerForgot: The GM covered part of the map of {scene} again.
Notice.playerForgotUnnamed: The GM covered part of the map again.

BEHAVIOR.label: Map Knowledge
BEHAVIOR.hint: Players learn an area of the map, or forget it, when a token enters the Region.

area.label: Area
area.hint: The Region whose area the players learn. Empty means this Region.

audience.label: Who learns it
audience.hint: With shared fog every player learns it.

hide.label: Hide instead
hide.hint: The players forget the area instead of learning it.

playersOnly.label: Only tokens of players
playersOnly.hint: Tokens that no player owns do not trigger it.

once.label: Only once
once.hint: The behavior switches itself off after the first time.

SELFTEST.Title: Map Knowledge self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks what Map Knowledge needs from Foundry and draws a small test map.
SELFTEST.Generation: Map Knowledge needs Foundry 14, this is {version}.
SELFTEST.FogApi: The fog of war of this Foundry version does not offer what Map Knowledge draws with.
SELFTEST.FogModes: The fog exploration modes are missing.
SELFTEST.Explorations: Stored fog explorations per Level are missing.
SELFTEST.Walls: The wall polygons for the room tool are missing.
SELFTEST.Behavior: The Region behavior is not registered.
SELFTEST.Layer: The Map Knowledge layer is missing on the canvas.
SELFTEST.Drawing: The test drawing into a fog texture failed.
SELFTEST.Problems: Map Knowledge: {problems} of {checks} checks found a problem.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Map Knowledge was tested with an older version ({versions}). Run the self test in its settings.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
